tools.name: discourse_select_site
tools.title: Select Site
tools.description: Validate and select a Discourse site. Returns JSON with site URL and title.

site.description: Base URL of the Discourse site

tools.name: discourse_search
tools.title: Discourse Search
tools.description: Search site content. Returns JSON object with results array of matching topics (id, slug, title) and meta (total, has_more).

tools.name: discourse_filter_topics
tools.title: Filter Topics
tools.description: Discover topics through a filtered, top, or hot view. Filtered uses Discourse TopicsFilter syntax; top uses Discourse's authoritative top score and defaults to weekly; hot is defined exactly as daily top (not sentiment, controversy, or real-time velocity). Returns a uniform rich topic projection and truthful pagination metadata.

filter.description: TopicsFilter query (required for the filtered view)

top_period.description: Top period (top view only; defaults to weekly)

tools.name: discourse_read_topic
tools.title: Read Topic
tools.description: Read topic metadata and posts. Large post limits can require multiple upstream requests. For moderation queues, prefer reviewable list/detail evidence instead of fanning this tool out across flagged topics.

tools.name: discourse_read_post
tools.title: Read Post
tools.description: Read a specific post. Returns JSON with id, topic_id, post_number, username, created_at, and raw content.

tools.name: discourse_read_topic_posts
tools.title: Read Selected Topic Posts
tools.description: Read exact, earliest, latest, around-post, or username-filtered topic evidence. Selection is bounded to 50 posts and reports the visible stream size without claiming the entire topic was loaded.

tools.name: discourse_get_post_replies
tools.title: Get Post Replies
tools.description: Read reply relationships for a post as recursive descendant IDs, bounded rich direct replies, or the upstream-bounded ancestor history. Preserves upstream ordering and references.

mode.description: reply_ids returns recursive descendant IDs; direct_replies returns up to 20 rich direct replies; reply_history returns ancestors

tools.name: discourse_list_latest_posts
tools.title: List Latest Posts
tools.description: List the site's latest visible posts using Discourse's fixed 50-post page and post-ID cursor. Anonymous upstream responses expire after one minute; results are a feed, not an exhaustive history.

tools.name: discourse_get_topic_view_stats
tools.title: Get Topic View Stats
tools.description: Get up to 300 ascending daily topic view counts. Views combine anonymous and logged-in views; they are not unique viewers or an engagement judgment.

tools.name: discourse_search_posts
tools.title: Search Posts
tools.description: Search post-level evidence with Discourse query syntax. Unlike discourse_search, this preserves matched posts, highlighted blurbs, authors, topics, categories, and truthful bounded continuation. This is keyword search, not Discourse AI semantic search.

tools.name: discourse_get_user
tools.title: Get User
tools.description: Get user info. Returns JSON with id, username, name, trust_level, created_at, bio, admin, and moderator.

tools.name: discourse_list_user_posts
tools.title: List User Posts
tools.description: Get paginated list of user posts/replies. Returns JSON object with posts array (id, topic_id, post_number, slug, title, created_at, excerpt, category_id) and meta (page, limit, has_more).

tools.name: discourse_get_user_summary
tools.title: Get User Summary
tools.description: Get profile-visible aggregate user activity, top topics/replies/links, interaction partners, categories, badges, likes, visits, reading, and post/topic counts. Missing metrics remain null when hidden or unavailable.

tools.name: discourse_list_user_actions
tools.title: List User Actions
tools.description: List a user's visible activity using model-friendly action names. Plugin-backed action families can legitimately be empty; emptiness does not prove that a feature is unavailable.

tools.name: discourse_list_directory_items
tools.title: List Directory Items
tools.description: List user-directory/cohort metrics with authoritative totals and continuation. Supports Discourse periods, ordering, visible groups, page 0-10, and the upstream maximum of 50 rows.

tools.name: discourse_list_users
tools.title: List Users
tools.description: List users via admin API. Requires admin API key. Returns ~100 users per page (Discourse's fixed page size). Returns JSON with users array and pagination meta.

filter.description: Search by username, email, or IP address

tools.name: discourse_get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get Chat Messages
tools.description: Get messages from a chat channel. Returns JSON object with channel_id, messages array (id, username, created_at, message, edited, thread_id, in_reply_to_id), and meta.

page_size.description: Number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 50)

target_message_id.description: Message ID to query around or paginate from

direction.description: Pagination direction: 'past' for older messages, 'future' for newer

target_date.description: ISO 8601 date string to query messages around

tools.name: discourse_get_draft
tools.title: Get Draft
tools.description: Retrieve a specific draft by key. Returns JSON with draft_key, sequence, and parsed data (title, reply, categoryId, tags, action).

tools.name: discourse_create_post
tools.title: Create Post
tools.description: Create a post in a topic. author_username requires a global API key. Returns the actual upstream author so callers can verify attribution.

tools.name: discourse_create_user
tools.title: Create User
tools.description: Create a user through Discourse's signup API using a global admin API key. Reports whether upstream confirmed creation; anti-enumeration responses without user_id remain indeterminate. Optional avatar assignment runs only after confirmed creation.

tools.name: discourse_create_category
tools.title: Create Category
tools.description: Create a new category. Returns JSON with id, slug, and name.

tools.name: discourse_create_topic
tools.title: Create Topic
tools.description: Create a new topic. author_username requires a global API key. Returns the actual upstream author so callers can verify attribution.

tools.name: discourse_update_topic
tools.title: Update Topic
tools.description: Update an existing topic (title, category, tags, featured_link). Returns JSON with updated topic details.

original_title.description: For conflict detection - expected current title

original_tags.description: For conflict detection - expected current tags

tools.name: discourse_update_post
tools.title: Update Post
tools.description: Update the content of an existing post. Returns JSON with updated post details.

tools.name: discourse_update_user
tools.title: Update User
tools.description: Update user profile fields. If upload_id is provided, also sets the user's avatar. Returns JSON with success status and updated user details.

tools.name: discourse_upload_file
tools.title: Upload File
tools.description: Upload an image or file to Discourse. Provide either: image_data (base64 with filename), a remote HTTP(S) URL, or an absolute local file path. user_id is required for avatar/background uploads. Returns upload_id for use in avatar/profile updates. Use short_url to embed images in posts.

image_data.description: Base64 image data (with or without data URI prefix)

url.description: Remote HTTP(S) URL for Discourse to fetch, or file:// URL / absolute local path

filename.description: Filename (required with image_data, optional for file paths)

tools.name: discourse_save_draft
tools.title: Create/Save Draft
tools.description: Create or update a draft. Returns JSON with draft_key and new sequence number.

draft_key.description: Draft key: "new_topic" for new topics, "topic_<id>" for replies (e.g., "topic_123")

sequence.description: Current sequence number (use 0 for new drafts, or the sequence from get for updates)

action.description: Draft action type (defaults based on draft_key)

tools.name: discourse_delete_draft
tools.title: Delete Draft
tools.description: Delete a draft by key. Requires current sequence number to prevent conflicts.

tools.name: discourse_get_query
tools.title: Get Data Explorer Query
tools.description: Get full details of a Data Explorer query including SQL and parameters. Requires admin API key.

tools.name: discourse_run_query
tools.title: Run Data Explorer Query
tools.description: Execute a Data Explorer query with parameters. Returns columns, rows, result_count, duration_ms. Queries run in read-only transactions with 10-second timeout. Requires admin API key.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: query default, use 'ALL' for unlimited)

explain.description: Include query execution plan in response

tools.name: discourse_create_query
tools.title: Create Data Explorer Query
tools.description: Create a new saved Data Explorer query. Requires admin API key and write access.

sql.description: SQL query. Declare parameters in comments: -- [params]\n-- int :user_id

group_ids.description: Group IDs allowed to run this query (empty = admin only)

tools.name: discourse_update_query
tools.title: Update Data Explorer Query
tools.description: Update an existing Data Explorer query. Only provided fields are updated. Requires admin API key and write access.

group_ids.description: New group IDs allowed to run this query

tools.name: discourse_delete_query
tools.title: Delete Data Explorer Query
tools.description: Soft-delete a Data Explorer query. The query can be restored by an admin. Requires admin API key and write access.

tools.name: discourse_list_private_messages
tools.title: List Private Messages
tools.description: List authenticated personal or group private-message mailboxes. Returns normalized JSON messages and pagination metadata.

tools.name: discourse_read_private_message
tools.title: Read Private Message
tools.description: Read an authenticated private message, its posts, and direct allowed-user and allowed-group records. Rejects public topics.

tools.name: discourse_create_private_message
tools.title: Create Private Message
tools.description: Create a private message for typed user, group, or email recipients. Unknown emails may create staged users. author_username requires a global API key; the response reports actual attribution.

tools.name: discourse_reply_private_message
tools.title: Reply to Private Message
tools.description: Safely reply to an existing private message after verifying its archetype. author_username requires a global API key; the response reports actual attribution.

tools.name: discourse_invite_to_private_message
tools.title: Invite to Private Message
tools.description: Add a user or group to a private message, or submit an opaque email invitation. Email success does not confirm delivery or participant access. author_username requires a global API key.

tools.name: discourse_list_groups
tools.title: List Groups
tools.description: List visible groups. Empty input exhaustively traverses the bounded directory; any explicit page or filter field preserves the existing single-page query behavior. Both modes return one structured envelope with truthful completion metadata and JSON text fallback. Opt in with the groups toolset.

tools.name: discourse_get_group
tools.title: Get Group
tools.description: Get complete visible group details by numeric ID or name, including caller capabilities and group settings.

tools.name: discourse_list_group_posts
tools.title: List Group Posts
tools.description: List visible posts authored by a group using Discourse's fixed 20-row page, ID or timestamp cursor, and optional category filter. Group authorship is cohort evidence, not proof of organizational responsibility.

tools.name: discourse_list_group_members
tools.title: List Group Members
tools.description: List a group's members and owners with filtering, ordering, and pagination. Visibility is enforced by Discourse.

tools.name: discourse_list_group_membership_requests
tools.title: List Group Membership Requests
tools.description: List pending membership requests and reasons for a group the caller can manage, with filtering and pagination.

tools.name: discourse_create_group
tools.title: Create Group
tools.description: Create a custom group with complete core settings, initial members and owners, custom fields, associations, and optional plugin fields. Requires staff group-creation permission.

tools.name: discourse_update_group
tools.title: Update Group
tools.description: Update all core group profile, visibility, admission, notification-default, association, email, SMTP, custom, and plugin settings supported by the caller and group type.

tools.name: discourse_delete_group
tools.title: Delete Group
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom group. Automatic groups cannot be deleted. Requires staff access.

tools.name: discourse_add_group_members_by_username
tools.title: Add Group Members by Username
tools.description: Add group members using canonical usernames. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

usernames.description: Canonical usernames of existing users; do not provide user IDs or email addresses

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_add_group_members_by_user_id
tools.title: Add Group Members by User ID
tools.description: Add group members using numeric user IDs. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_ids.description: Numeric IDs of existing users; numbers must not be quoted as strings

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_add_group_members_by_email
tools.title: Add Group Members by Email
tools.description: Add group members using email addresses belonging to existing accounts. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_emails.description: Email addresses that already belong to user accounts; use the invitation tool for unknown addresses

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_invite_group_members_by_email
tools.title: Invite Group Members by Email
tools.description: Add existing accounts immediately when an address matches, and invite unknown addresses to the forum with this group preassigned. Use add_group_members_by_email when every address is known to belong to an account.

emails.description: Email addresses to invite to the forum and add to this group after redemption

skip_email.description: Create invitations without sending invitation email

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_members_by_username
tools.title: Remove Group Members by Username
tools.description: Remove group members using canonical usernames. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

usernames.description: Canonical usernames of existing users; do not provide user IDs or email addresses

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_members_by_user_id
tools.title: Remove Group Members by User ID
tools.description: Remove group members using numeric user IDs. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_ids.description: Numeric IDs of existing users; numbers must not be quoted as strings

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_members_by_email
tools.title: Remove Group Members by Email
tools.description: Remove group members using email addresses belonging to existing accounts. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_emails.description: Email addresses that already belong to user accounts; use the invitation tool for unknown addresses

tools.name: discourse_add_group_owners_by_username
tools.title: Add Group Owners by Username
tools.description: Add group owners using canonical usernames. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

usernames.description: Canonical usernames of existing users; do not provide user IDs or email addresses

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_add_group_owners_by_user_id
tools.title: Add Group Owners by User ID
tools.description: Add group owners using numeric user IDs. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_ids.description: Numeric IDs of existing users; numbers must not be quoted as strings

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_add_group_owners_by_email
tools.title: Add Group Owners by Email
tools.description: Add group owners using email addresses belonging to existing accounts. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_emails.description: Email addresses that already belong to user accounts; use the invitation tool for unknown addresses

notify_users.description: Notify users added as members or owners

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_owners_by_username
tools.title: Remove Group Owners by Username
tools.description: Remove group owners using canonical usernames. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

usernames.description: Canonical usernames of existing users; do not provide user IDs or email addresses

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_owners_by_user_id
tools.title: Remove Group Owners by User ID
tools.description: Remove group owners using numeric user IDs. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_ids.description: Numeric IDs of existing users; numbers must not be quoted as strings

tools.name: discourse_remove_group_owners_by_email
tools.title: Remove Group Owners by Email
tools.description: Remove group owners using email addresses belonging to existing accounts. This tool accepts only this identifier type, avoiding ambiguous selector precedence.

user_emails.description: Email addresses that already belong to user accounts; use the invitation tool for unknown addresses

tools.name: discourse_handle_group_membership_request
tools.title: Handle Group Membership Request
tools.description: Approve or deny one pending group membership request. Approval adds the requester to the group; denial only removes the request.

tools.name: discourse_request_group_membership
tools.title: Request Group Membership
tools.description: Request membership in a visible group that allows requests, sending the reason to its owners.

tools.name: discourse_join_group
tools.title: Join Group
tools.description: Join a visible group that allows public admission as the authenticated user.

tools.name: discourse_leave_group
tools.title: Leave Group
tools.description: Leave a group that allows public exit as the authenticated user.

tools.name: discourse_search_tag_groups
tools.title: Search Tag Groups
tools.description: Public visibility-filtered tag-group search. q and names combine with AND semantics; upstream treats % and _ in q as SQL LIKE wildcards. Results intentionally omit group IDs, parent tags, and permissions and are not authoritative staff inventory. Exact case-insensitive group name is the supported correlation key. Always sends an explicit limit and reports possible truncation.

tools.name: discourse_list_tag_groups
tools.title: List Tag Groups
tools.description: Authoritative unpaginated tag-group inventory ordered by name. Requires a locally configured API credential and upstream staff authority; Discourse returns a privacy-preserving 404 to non-staff. Staff reads can work when tagging is disabled. Returns canonical tags, parent, one-per-topic, explicit permissions entries ({group_id, access}; group_id 0 is everyone), and optimistic state hashes.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

tools.name: discourse_get_tag_group
tools.title: Get Tag Group
tools.description: Get authoritative tag-group state by ID. Requires a locally configured API credential and upstream staff authority. The deterministic state_hash is an MCP optimistic precondition, not an upstream atomic lock; a race remains possible after preflight.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

tools.name: discourse_create_tag_group
tools.title: Create Tag Group
tools.description: Create a tag group with an explicit complete permission list such as permissions: [{group_id: 0, access: "full"}] for everyone, nonempty members, an optional parent selector, and one-per-topic policy. Omit parent_tag or use null when there is no parent; blank placeholders are safely treated as omitted. New tag names require allow_tag_creation=true because they create persistent tags and trigger normal indexing/plugin hooks. Duplicate-name and ID checks are advisory; upstream staff authority, tagging_enabled, and constraints remain authoritative.

parent_tag.description: Optional parent tag selector. Omit or use null when there is no parent; blank string placeholders are treated as omitted.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

tools.name: discourse_update_tag_group
tools.title: Update Tag Group
tools.description: Safely replace complete tag-group state after a fresh expected_state_hash preflight. Omitted mutable fields are preserved locally, but Discourse receives full tags, parent, one-per-topic, and permissions because partial upstream bodies clear state. For parent_tag, omit or pass a blank placeholder to preserve the current parent; pass null to clear it. Permissions use explicit {group_id, access} entries; group_id 0 means everyone. Tag/parent removals, permission replacement, and possible materialization of serializer-synthesized everyone/full permissions require explicit acknowledgements. The hash is advisory rather than an upstream atomic lock; uncertain post-dispatch outcomes must not be retried blindly.

parent_tag.description: Optional parent tag selector. Omit or use null when there is no parent; blank string placeholders are treated as omitted.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

tools.name: discourse_delete_tag_group
tools.title: Delete Tag Group
tools.description: Permanently delete one exact tag group after fresh name/state-hash checks and explicit acknowledgements for category relationship cascades and unresolved plugin dependencies. Deletion removes memberships, permissions, and category allowed/required relationships, but not tags or topic-tag rows. Dependency discovery is not exhaustive (plugins such as RSS polling may depend on groups). Scoped API keys may not include this delete route. A 200 response is only dispatch acknowledgement; absence is verified before success.

group_id.description: Numeric Discourse group ID. Use 0 for the built-in everyone group.

access.description: Tag permission for this group: full allows use; readonly allows visibility without use.

permissions.description: Complete tag-group permission list. Use [{"group_id":0,"access":"full"}] for everyone with full access.

tools.name: discourse_get_review_queue_count
tools.title: Get Review Queue Count
tools.description: Get the authoritative count of pending reviewable records visible to the authenticated user. This counts queue items, not individual flag/score records; upstream Guardian permissions remain authoritative.

tools.name: discourse_list_reviewables
tools.title: List Reviewables
tools.description: Work through the exhaustive visible Discourse queue in pages of 10. For ordinary triage, call with only status=pending and offset=0—do not guess topic/category/type filters. Use meta.total and follow next_offset while has_more is true. Each result already includes bounded evidence and exact dynamic actions; fetch detail only for a shortlisted item that needs fresher context.

offset.description: Queue offset; start at 0 and follow meta.next_offset

type.description: Exact reviewable class such as ReviewableFlaggedPost; blank/all/any means no type filter

topic_id.description: Exact topic ID; omit or use 0 for no topic filter

category_id.description: Exact category ID; omit or use 0 for no category filter

priority.description: Exact upstream priority filter; omit or pass blank for all priorities

username.description: Target username filter; omit or pass blank for all users

reviewed_by.description: Reviewer username; omit or pass blank for all reviewers

claimed_by.description: Claiming moderator username; omit or pass blank for all claim states

flagged_by.description: Flagger username; omit or pass blank for all flaggers

from_date.description: Inclusive ISO date/time lower bound; omit or pass blank for no lower bound

to_date.description: Inclusive ISO date/time upper bound; omit or pass blank for no upper bound

sort_order.description: Exact upstream queue sort order; omit or pass blank for Discourse's default

score_type.description: Exact upstream score type; omit or pass blank for all score types

tools.name: discourse_list_reviewable_topics
tools.title: List Reviewable Topics
tools.description: Non-exhaustive topic-level signal only: list pending topics at or above Discourse's minimum review priority. Do not use this tool to work through or rank the full queue because it omits reviewable IDs, actions, low-priority items, and items without topics. Use discourse_list_reviewables for moderation triage.

tools.name: discourse_get_reviewable
tools.title: Get Reviewable
tools.description: Refresh one shortlisted reviewable's bounded context, current version, claim state, scores, and exact dynamic actions. Paginated list results already include evidence/actions, so do not fan this tool out across the queue. Optionally includes Discourse's score explanation; never generates a recommendation.

tools.name: discourse_get_user_moderation_summary
tools.title: Get User Moderation Summary
tools.description: Get staff-authorized behavioral moderation counters for a user. Omits unrelated administrative capability flags; Discourse permissions remain authoritative.

tools.name: discourse_get_post_revision
tools.title: Get Post Revision
tools.description: Get a staff/Guardian-authorized post revision with bounded diffs, edit reason, actor, version, and hidden-state evidence.

tools.name: discourse_perform_reviewable_action
tools.title: Perform Reviewable Action
tools.description: Perform one exact dynamic action after a fresh serialized preflight. Choose by the action's full description, not label alone (for example delete-and-agree differs from delete-and-ignore). The displayed action ID may be UI-prefixed; this tool safely routes its server_action. Requires confirm=true and write enablement.

action_id.description: Exact available_actions[].id from the current reviewable; the MCP maps its server_action to the route

expected_version.description: Version observed during review; fail closed if it has changed

additional_fields.description: Only fields advertised by the selected dynamic action contract

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement that the selected action may delete content, delete users, or block accounts

tools.name: discourse_list_workflows
tools.title: List Workflows
tools.description: List compact Discourse Workflow summaries. Requires an admin API key.

tools.name: discourse_get_workflow
tools.title: Get Workflow
tools.description: Get the complete round-trippable workflow graph. GET immediately before updating it.

tools.name: discourse_list_workflow_node_types
tools.title: List Workflow Node Types
tools.description: List a slim catalog, or pass identifier for schemas, ports, and output contracts. Authoring loop: inspect the slim node catalog, request identifiers for schemas and output keys, resolve entity ids, create from a template or complete graph, GET before edits, test the draft, then publish. Interpolating strings start with =. Filter/if use leftValue/rightValue and output ports true/false. Connection type is the source output key, not always main. Prefer declarative nodes over action:code. Manual runs execute the current draft. Omitting a node on whole-graph update deletes it. nodes and connections must always be sent together.

tools.name: discourse_resolve_workflow_entity
tools.title: Resolve Workflow Entity
tools.description: Resolve category, tag, group, user, badge, chat channel, or data-table ids for workflow parameters.

tools.name: discourse_list_workflow_templates
tools.title: List Workflow Templates
tools.description: List templates or retrieve a complete template graph by id. Authoring loop: inspect the slim node catalog, request identifiers for schemas and output keys, resolve entity ids, create from a template or complete graph, GET before edits, test the draft, then publish. Interpolating strings start with =. Filter/if use leftValue/rightValue and output ports true/false. Connection type is the source output key, not always main. Prefer declarative nodes over action:code. Manual runs execute the current draft. Omitting a node on whole-graph update deletes it. nodes and connections must always be sent together.

tools.name: discourse_list_workflow_executions
tools.title: List Workflow Executions
tools.description: List global or per-workflow execution history.

tools.name: discourse_get_workflow_execution
tools.title: Get Workflow Execution
tools.description: Poll an execution for status, errors, timing, trigger data, and steps.

tools.name: discourse_list_workflow_versions
tools.title: List Workflow Versions
tools.description: List workflow version history and UUIDs available for restore.

tools.name: discourse_list_workflow_credentials
tools.title: List Workflow Credentials
tools.description: List workflow credentials with secrets redacted. Credential creation remains in the admin UI.

tools.name: discourse_evaluate_workflow_expression
tools.title: Evaluate Workflow Expression
tools.description: Evaluate a workflow expression without mutating the forum. Interpolating expressions start with =.

tools.name: discourse_create_workflow
tools.title: Create Workflow
tools.description: Create a draft from a complete small graph or template. Prefer a complete graph over blank creation. Authoring loop: inspect the slim node catalog, request identifiers for schemas and output keys, resolve entity ids, create from a template or complete graph, GET before edits, test the draft, then publish. Interpolating strings start with =. Filter/if use leftValue/rightValue and output ports true/false. Connection type is the source output key, not always main. Prefer declarative nodes over action:code. Manual runs execute the current draft. Omitting a node on whole-graph update deletes it. nodes and connections must always be sent together.

tools.name: discourse_update_workflow
tools.title: Update Workflow
tools.description: GET first. A replace PUT replaces the whole draft graph; omitted nodes are deleted. Use complete nodes+connections or operations[], never both. Authoring loop: inspect the slim node catalog, request identifiers for schemas and output keys, resolve entity ids, create from a template or complete graph, GET before edits, test the draft, then publish. Interpolating strings start with =. Filter/if use leftValue/rightValue and output ports true/false. Connection type is the source output key, not always main. Prefer declarative nodes over action:code. Manual runs execute the current draft. Omitting a node on whole-graph update deletes it. nodes and connections must always be sent together.

tools.name: discourse_delete_workflow
tools.title: Delete Workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete a workflow. Fails when another workflow calls it.

tools.name: discourse_discard_workflow_draft
tools.title: Discard Workflow Draft
tools.description: Replace the draft with its published snapshot. Requires an existing published version.

tools.name: discourse_restore_workflow_version
tools.title: Restore Workflow Version
tools.description: Restore a historical workflow version by UUID into the draft.

tools.name: discourse_run_workflow
tools.title: Run Workflow Draft
tools.description: Run the current unpublished draft asynchronously. This can create posts, send chat, or call external HTTP; poll the returned execution id.

tools.name: discourse_run_workflow_step
tools.title: Run Workflow Step
tools.description: Run one non-trigger, non-waiting draft node asynchronously. Requires upstream pin-data or a prior successful run.

tools.name: discourse_update_workflow_pin_data
tools.title: Update Workflow Pin Data
tools.description: Pin test items to a node name, or omit items to unpin it.

tools.name: discourse_ai_list_agents
tools.title: List AI Agents
tools.description: List concise Discourse AI agent summaries and slim tool/model metadata. Defaults to slim; use discourse_ai_get_agent to load one full configuration, or view=full only when the complete index is explicitly needed. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_get_agent
tools.title: Get AI Agent
tools.description: Get the full editable configuration of one Discourse AI agent. Custom tools use custom-<id>; native tools use native-<id> in tool tuples.

tools.name: discourse_ai_create_agent
tools.title: Create AI Agent
tools.description: Create a typed Discourse AI agent, including an optional subagent delegation allowlist of up to 20 existing agent IDs. Requires admin credentials and write mode. Tool entries may be names or [name, options, force] tuples.

subagent_ids.description: Up to 20 existing AI agent IDs this agent may delegate to; IDs may include negative system-agent IDs

tools.name: discourse_ai_update_agent
tools.title: Update AI Agent
tools.description: Partially update one AI agent, including enabled state, permissions, model, prompt, tools, subagent delegation, and RAG configuration. Only supplied fields are sent. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

subagent_ids.description: Up to 20 existing AI agent IDs this agent may delegate to; IDs may include negative system-agent IDs

tools.name: discourse_ai_delete_agent
tools.title: Delete AI Agent
tools.description: Delete a non-system AI agent. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_create_agent_user
tools.title: Create AI Agent User
tools.description: Explicitly create the bot user used by an AI agent for mention/chat entry points. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_export_agent
tools.title: Export AI Agent
tools.description: Export a portable AI agent bundle. It may include referenced custom-tool definitions but excludes secret bindings. Treat prompts and scripts as sensitive.

tools.name: discourse_ai_import_agent
tools.title: Import AI Agent
tools.description: Import a portable AI agent bundle. The bundle may create or overwrite embedded custom tools. force requires confirm_force=true. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_get_custom_tool_guide
tools.title: Get AI Custom Tool Guide
tools.description: Retrieve one focused MiniRacer authoring topic. Usually pass only topic. preset_id is optional and used only with topic=presets to load one live example; extra preset_id values on other topics are ignored. Requires admin credentials.

topic.description: Focused guide section. Use presets to browse or retrieve live preset examples.

preset_id.description: Optional live preset ID used only when topic=presets; ignored for every other topic.

tools.name: discourse_ai_list_custom_tools
tools.title: List AI Custom Tools
tools.description: List concise database-backed custom-tool summaries and compact live preset metadata. Scripts, bindings, verbose parameter descriptions, and full records are omitted; use discourse_ai_get_custom_tool or the guide's preset lookup to zoom in. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_get_custom_tool
tools.title: Get AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Get one database-backed scripted AI tool, including source and configured secret bindings. Treat the response as sensitive. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_create_custom_tool
tools.title: Create AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Create a database-backed synchronous MiniRacer scripted tool. Call discourse_ai_get_custom_tool_guide before authoring. Never provide raw secret values. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_update_custom_tool
tools.title: Update AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Partially update a scripted tool. Call the guide before substantial script changes. Omitted scalar fields and RAG uploads are preserved; changing secret_contracts can prune orphan bindings unless secret_bindings are supplied. Raw secret values are never accepted. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_delete_custom_tool
tools.title: Delete AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Delete a scripted tool. Agents referencing it may stop functioning as configured. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_test_custom_tool
tools.title: Test AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Actually execute a persisted or unsaved custom-tool script. It can make external requests and cause side effects; this is not dry validation. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_export_custom_tool
tools.title: Export AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Export portable custom-tool JSON. Discourse excludes secret bindings; MCP also strips them defensively. Treat script source as sensitive. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_import_custom_tool
tools.title: Import AI Custom Tool
tools.description: Import portable custom-tool JSON. force overwrites a matching tool_name and requires confirm_force=true. Secret IDs may be bound, but raw secret values are never accepted. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_ai_list_features
tools.title: List AI Features
tools.description: List visible computed Discourse AI modules, feature enabled state, assigned agents, and effective LLMs. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_get_feature_config
tools.title: Get AI Feature Configuration
tools.description: Resolve a visible feature module ID and return its computed state plus editable settings from its exact ai-features/<module> area. Credential settings are omitted. Requires admin credentials.

tools.name: discourse_ai_update_feature_config
tools.title: Update AI Feature Configuration
tools.description: Atomically bulk-update only non-secret settings freshly exposed by one exact AI feature area, with optional compare-before-write original_values. Refreshes effective state afterward. Production behavior changes immediately. Requires admin credentials and write mode.

tools.name: discourse_list_categories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: Exhaustively list categories visible to the selected identity through bounded pagination. Returns stable IDs, slugs, hierarchy (parent_category_id; pid is a legacy alias), access flags, counts, structured completion metadata, and JSON text fallback. Opt in with the administration toolset.

tools.name: discourse_list_site_settings
tools.title: List Site Settings
tools.description: List admin-visible Discourse site settings with bounded metadata, optionally returning only settings whose current value differs from the default. Secret and credential-like values are always masked.

tools.name: discourse_manage_user_activation
tools.title: Manage User Activation
tools.description: Activate, approve, activate-and-approve, or deactivate one user through Discourse's authoritative admin routes. Requires explicit confirmation and upstream staff authorization.

confirm.description: Must be true because this changes account access state

tools.name: discourse_update_site_setting
tools.title: Update Site Setting
tools.description: Set or reset one ordinary admin-visible Discourse site setting after a fresh optimistic-concurrency check. Secret and structured settings are excluded.

tools.name: discourse_list_webhooks
tools.title: List Webhooks
tools.description: List safe webhook summaries and the live authoring catalog without exposing webhook secrets or destination credentials.

tools.name: discourse_get_webhook
tools.title: Get Webhook
tools.description: Get one fresh safe webhook configuration for inspection and mutation preconditions.

tools.name: discourse_create_webhook
tools.title: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a guarded outbound webhook using the live event and content-type catalog. External delivery and risky options require explicit confirmation.

tools.name: discourse_update_webhook
tools.title: Update Webhook
tools.description: Partially update a webhook after fresh destination and active-state preconditions. Relationship arrays are complete replacements.

tools.name: discourse_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete one webhook after a fresh exact destination-fingerprint precondition.

tools.name: discourse_list_webhook_events
tools.title: List Webhook Events
tools.description: List bounded webhook delivery diagnostics. Payload and response previews are omitted unless explicitly confirmed.

tools.name: discourse_ping_webhook
tools.title: Ping Webhook
tools.description: Enqueue one explicitly confirmed external webhook ping after a fresh destination precondition.

tools.name: discourse_redeliver_webhook_event
tools.title: Redeliver Webhook Event
tools.description: Redeliver exactly one old webhook event after destination, ownership, and status preconditions. Bulk redelivery is not exposed.

tools.name: discourse_list_themes
tools.title: List Themes
tools.description: List admin-visible Discourse themes and components. This opt-in admin read returns bounded summaries and local pagination; it does not expose theme source code.

tools.name: discourse_get_theme
tools.title: Get Theme
tools.description: Inspect one local, ZIP-imported, or Git-backed Discourse theme/component as an administrator. Source values are bounded, opt-in, and may be unavailable for remote records; private key material is never returned.

tools.name: discourse_create_theme
tools.title: Create Theme
tools.description: Create a local Discourse theme or component. For textual HTML/SCSS/JS fields provide value and omit upload_id; for assets provide numeric upload_id with type=upload and omit value. Supplied code can execute or deploy for visitors; explicit confirmations and admin write access are required.

value.description: Complete textual field content. Do not provide upload_id.

type.description: Friendly textual field type; omit when Discourse can infer it

anyOf.description: Text field replacement: value is required and upload_id is not accepted

upload_id.description: Numeric upload ID returned by discourse_upload_theme_asset

anyOf.description: Upload field replacement: numeric upload_id and type=upload are required; value is not accepted

fields.description: Optional populated fields. Each item is either a text replacement with value, or an upload replacement with numeric upload_id and type=upload.

tools.name: discourse_install_theme
tools.title: Install Theme
tools.description: Install a Git repository or ZIP/gzip archive. Set source to exactly one nested variant: {kind:repository, remote_url...}, {kind:archive, archive_data...}, or {kind:archive, archive_path...}; never add placeholder fields from another variant. External code and migrations can have site-wide impact and are not sandboxed.

remote_url.description: Git repository URL; archive inputs are not part of this variant

archive_path.description: Absolute local path or file:// URL beneath allowed_upload_paths

source.description: Choose exactly one repository, base64 archive, or local archive source variant. Never add placeholder fields from another variant.

tools.name: discourse_update_theme
tools.title: Update Theme Metadata
tools.description: Update bounded metadata, default status, or complete theme-component relationships. Relationship arrays replace the entire graph side; source, settings, translations, and remote refresh are intentionally excluded.

tools.name: discourse_update_theme_fields
tools.title: Update Theme Fields
tools.description: Replace or explicitly delete selected fields on a local or ZIP-imported theme. Text replacements require value and prohibit upload_id; asset replacements require numeric upload_id with type=upload and prohibit value. This can deploy executable code; Git-backed and system themes are rejected.

value.description: Complete textual field content. Do not provide upload_id.

type.description: Friendly textual field type; omit when Discourse can infer it

anyOf.description: Text field replacement: value is required and upload_id is not accepted

upload_id.description: Numeric upload ID returned by discourse_upload_theme_asset

anyOf.description: Upload field replacement: numeric upload_id and type=upload are required; value is not accepted
Explicit field deletion: value, upload_id, and type are not accepted

tools.name: discourse_update_theme_setting
tools.title: Update Theme Setting
tools.description: Set or explicitly revert one declared setting owned by a theme/component. This does not mutate themeable global site settings; object values are validated upstream against the declared schema.

tools.name: discourse_update_theme_translations
tools.title: Update Theme Translations
tools.description: Replace values for explicit translation keys declared by a theme, after a fresh locale read. Unknown keys are rejected; deletion/revert is not supported in this release.

tools.name: discourse_sync_remote_theme
tools.title: Sync Remote Theme
tools.description: Check or install updates for an existing Git-backed theme. Both actions clone external code and persist state; update deploys code and runs settings migrations, requiring explicit confirmations.

tools.name: discourse_upload_theme_asset
tools.title: Upload Theme Asset
tools.description: Upload a bounded local/base64 asset for later attachment to a theme field. No remote URL fetch is supported; upload alone does not attach or deploy the asset.

tools.name: discourse_delete_theme
tools.title: Delete Theme
tools.description: Permanently delete one non-system, non-default theme/component after a fresh exact-name check. Dependencies are not detached automatically and bulk deletion is not exposed.

tools.name: discourse_list_reports
tools.title: List Reports
tools.description: Discover staff-visible Discourse report identifiers and metadata. The catalog is authoritative because core and plugins can add or hide reports.

tools.name: discourse_get_report
tools.title: Get Report
tools.description: Execute one discovered staff-visible Discourse report with dates, facets, typed filters, limit, and upstream caching. This exposes existing reports, not arbitrary SQL.

tools.name: discourse_get_support_dashboard
tools.title: Get Solved Support Dashboard
tools.description: Get the staff Solved support dashboard. Requires Discourse Solved. 'Unanswered' means unsolved with no qualifying regular reply, not no reply from a configured support team.

tools.name: discourse_ai_get_topic_summary
tools.title: Get Discourse AI Topic Summary
tools.description: Retrieve an existing cached upstream Discourse AI topic summary, including algorithm and staleness evidence. Requires Discourse AI; this tool does not generate or claim complete MCP-authored output.

tools.name: discourse_ai_semantic_search
tools.title: Discourse AI Semantic Search
tools.description: Run Guardian-filtered Discourse AI semantic search and return bounded grouped post/topic evidence. Requires Discourse AI embeddings. Results are bounded and expose no fabricated page cursor.

hyde.description: Explicitly disable HyDE. Omit to use the site's configured behavior; upstream does not reliably support enabling it per request.

tools.name: discourse_ai_list_sentiment_posts
tools.title: List Discourse AI Sentiment Posts
tools.description: List staff-visible posts classified positive, negative, or neutral by Discourse AI for an exact category/tag and date window. Classification is model output, not proof of tone, satisfaction, risk, or an argument.

resources.name: site_categories
resources.description: DEPRECATED compatibility resource. Use discourse_list_categories (opt-in administration toolset) for the canonical structured directory. Lists categories with hierarchy (parent_category_id; legacy pid), optional permissions (perms), counts, and truthful completeness metadata.

resources.name: site_tags
resources.description: List all tags with usage counts. Returns empty if tags are disabled.

resources.name: site_groups
resources.description: DEPRECATED compatibility resource. Use discourse_list_groups (opt-in groups toolset) for the canonical structured directory. Lists all visible groups with visibility and interaction levels plus truthful completeness metadata.

resources.name: chat_channels
resources.description: List all public chat channels with id, title, slug, status, members_count, and description.

resources.name: user_chat_channels
resources.description: List user's chat channels (public + DMs) with unread/mention counts. Requires authentication.

resources.name: user_drafts
resources.description: List user's drafts with draft_key, sequence, title, category_id, created_at, and reply_preview. Requires authentication.

resources.name: explorer_schema
resources.description: Database schema (core tables). Format: col, col:int, col:ts, col*, col>fk_table. No type = text. Use explorer_schema_tables for all/specific tables.

resources.name: explorer_queries
resources.description: Saved Data Explorer queries (30/page, by last used). Shows id, name, description. Use explorer_queries_page for other pages.

resources.name: ai_custom_tools_authoring_guide
resources.title: Discourse AI Custom Tool Authoring Guide
resources.description: Authoritative selected-site JavaScript preamble and minimal MiniRacer tool template. Admin-only; intended for assistant authoring context.

resourceTemplates.name: explorer_schema_tables
resourceTemplates.description: Database schema for specific tables. Use 'all' for all tables, or comma-separated names (e.g., 'users,topics,posts').

resourceTemplates.name: explorer_queries_page
resourceTemplates.description: Saved Data Explorer queries - specific page number.

prompts.name: sql_query
prompts.description: Guided workflow for database queries: discover schema, write SQL, run queries via Data Explorer

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What you want to learn from the data

description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server that exposes Discourse forum capabilities as tools and resources for AI agents. Choose a site with `discourse_select_site`, or start the server tethered to one with `--site`. Writes are off by default: write tools register only with `--allow_writes`, and the opt-in domains (moderation, workflows, AI administration and others) only with `--toolsets`. This reference lists every tool, as the server registers them with `--toolsets all --allow_writes`.
